# Start From Nowhere

> Adaptive test-prep platform with two live trainers: the GMAT Focus Edition (scored 205 to 805) and the digital SAT (scored 400 to 1600). Free first practice round, no account needed: per-skill ratings keyed to each exam's official score-report labels, spaced review of misses, timing diagnostics, games, flashcards, and full mock exams. The SAT trainer reproduces the real section-adaptive format, running each section as two modules with the second routed by performance on the first. Also home to an independent MBA rankings library covering 91 US full-time programs with a source and year on every figure, a community forum, and The Study Room blog.

## Product
- [GMAT Trainer](https://startfromnowhere.com/app/): adaptive GMAT Focus practice, 448 original items across Quantitative Reasoning, Verbal Reasoning, and Data Insights, plus 120 flashcards and six practice games.
- [SAT Trainer](https://startfromnowhere.com/sat/app/): adaptive digital SAT practice, 248 original items across the eight official content domains, with two-module mock sections that route like the real exam, student-produced responses, 112 flashcards, and a playbook per domain. Reports accuracy and per-domain results rather than an unofficial 400 to 1600 score.
- [MBA Rankings](https://startfromnowhere.com/schools/): 91 US full-time MBA programs; a transparent composite of US News, Financial Times, Bloomberg, QS, and Poets and Quants plus a documented data score; every class-profile figure cites the school's own page. One profile page per school.
- [Exam Guides](https://startfromnowhere.com/exams/): structure, timing, cost, and registration for GMAT, GRE, LSAT, MCAT, SAT, ACT, and Executive Assessment, each fact sourced.
- [Community Forum](https://startfromnowhere.com/community/): free to read and post, named or anonymous, human-moderated.
- [Pricing](https://startfromnowhere.com/pricing/): Free, Plus $9.99/mo, Pro $19.99/mo; everything free while we build.
- [Homepage](https://startfromnowhere.com/): how the adaptive engine works.

## Guides (The Study Room)
- [How long to study for the GMAT](https://startfromnowhere.com/blog/how-long-to-study-for-gmat/): realistic 8 week plan.
- [What is a good GMAT score in 2026](https://startfromnowhere.com/blog/good-gmat-score-2026/): Class of 2027 school figures with sources, Focus and Classic labeled.
- [GMAT scoring scale explained](https://startfromnowhere.com/blog/gmat-score-chart-percentiles/): the 205 to 805 scale and official GMAC concordance.
- [GMAT vs GRE for MBA](https://startfromnowhere.com/blog/gmat-vs-gre-for-mba/): even-handed comparison.
- [All articles](https://startfromnowhere.com/blog/)

## Policies
- Every school statistic on this site names its source and year; unverifiable figures show a dash, never a guess. GMAT Focus (205 to 805) and Classic (200 to 800) scores are never mixed or converted.
- Practice items are original; score bands are internal estimates, not official scores. GMAT is a trademark of GMAC, which does not endorse this product.
- [Terms](https://startfromnowhere.com/terms.html), [Privacy](https://startfromnowhere.com/privacy.html)
